name: SPXI instruments: the methods of spxi.dev/methods carried on other surfaces
rule: A surface listed here labels itself, visibly and in its machine-readable head, with the method it carries, its level and a link to its row in the inventory. 'Instrument of' is kept apart from 'treated by': the SPXI-TLP layer a surface also carries says how it was built, the instrument label says what it is.

instruments.name: Provenance Erasure Rate (PER, with PER-M / PER-C / PER-D)
instruments.what: Frequency with which attribution is dropped from compositions that use the entity's content; target < 0.2. Three atomic dimensions (mention, citation, definition) scored separately.

surfaces.note: The Provenance Erasure Rate is also the Semantic Economy's measure of provenance loss.

instruments.name: Semantic Addresses Framework
instruments.what: A query string plus its operators is an address; observations at an address are classed and canonicalized; one record per address. The unit the Capture Registry is keyed on.

instruments.name: Capture Registry (longitudinal observation)
instruments.what: Dated compositions at named addresses with surface, sign-in condition, verbatim transcript, re-run URL. Nulls recorded as nulls. 484 addresses, 651 observations at v12.1; current counts at alexanarch.org/captures/index.json.

instruments.name: Conformance Instrument
instruments.what: Runnable audit of the twelve deliverables of the standing protocol against server-delivered HTML; per-deliverable pass/fail and a score. JS-dependent identity content scores absent by design.

instruments.name: Platform Erosion Observatory
instruments.what: Measurement of what happens to records after removal from a host: survival in aggregators, tombstone behaviour, the shape of absence; a 14,284-DOI control cohort.

instruments.name: The Negative of the Negative (/non)
instruments.what: Public knowledge of an entity composed three ways and kept as one row: as the composition layer gave it at its addresses, as its own disclosed sources give it (the field, L(B)), and with the Crimson Hexagonal Archive admitted on equal terms, ontology included; the row records what the composition at an address does with the field it disclosed, and is adjudicated later against what the world does. Each entry carries an AXN in the family NON; entries at alexanarch.org/non/index.json.

instruments.name: The opening (a pinned Wikipedia revision, read sentence by sentence)
instruments.what: Each sentence of a pinned revision read against the sources it cites and the sources its article cites elsewhere, under the policy texts it was written against: the innocent reading first; source fidelity, primary-text adequacy and operative retention kept apart; every quotation checked against the full source; two independent passes; the reading kept as evidence. Run as a service at gnosis.spxi.dev (SPXI-gnΩsis), priced from measured cost; a commission also composes the entity's /non row (0.16).

instruments.name: Canary sequences and the Canary Registry
instruments.what: Planted strings whose appearance in a model's output is evidence of ingestion; public audit surface.
